code.title: Code
code.description: Identifier assigned by the customer or buyer for internal routing purposes.

identities.title: Identities
identities.description:
Any additional Codes, IDs, SKUs, or other regional or custom
identifiers that may be used to identify the order.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Buyer accounting reference cost code associated with the document.

period.title: Period
period.description:
Period of time that the document refers to often used in addition to the details
provided in the individual line items.

buyer.title: Buyer
buyer.description: Party who is responsible for issuing payment, if not the same as the customer.

seller.title: Seller
seller.description: Party liable to pay taxes on the transaction, if not the same as the supplier.

issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.description:
Third party responsible for issuing the document, but not responsible for tax.
Required by some tax regimes and formats.

addressee.title: Addressee
addressee.description: Third party to whom the document is addressed, but who is not the customer.

purchases.title: Purchase Orders
purchases.description: Purchase orders issued by the customer or buyer.

sales.title: Sales Orders
sales.description: Sales orders issued by the supplier or seller.

tender.title: Tender Advice
tender.description: Call for tender or lot the document relates to.

bill.Ordering.description: Ordering contains information about the commercial process and documents used to prepare the invoice, including orders, contracts, projects, preceding documents, and parties involved in issuing or addressing the invoice.
